text:
Olivia (mktg): Quick question — can we lock a 30m slot for a quickfire webinar next Tue? 20m content + 10m Q&A. I pushed a draft runbook here: https://go.redwood/webinar-quickfire-draft. Please skim and drop comments.

Raj (growth): I can take lead on topic selection. My pick: 'Quickfire: inference profiles — practical tradeoffs between latency and per-token cost' — 4 micro-demos, each 3–7 minutes. Thoughts?

Mia (speaker-ops): Love it. Speaker ops q: who covers benchmarking vs who runs the Dedicated vs Hosted demos? @Tomas will you host?

Tomas (host): I can host and do the Dedicated demo. Sam, can you take hosted/edge throughput snippet?

Sam (eng): Yep. I'll prep a 90s live demo showing tail-latency differences with varying batch sizes. Need a small sample dataset and a pre-quantized model to keep latency tight.

Jen (content): I'll write two 30s abstract blurbs for the landing page. Can we get a short customer quote to use in promo? @Nora any chances?

Nora (customer-success): Customer A is ok with a one-liner. I’ll ping them now and aim for confirmation EOD.

Alex (design): Slide ask: 3 visual panels — cost vs latency curve, KV-cache schematic, and a compact run-of-show timeline. I can mock tomorrow morning.

Raj (growth): Proposed rehearsal plan:
- Wed: 30m tech-only dry-run (recording + slides + slide control)
- Fri: 45m full dress (timed run + segues + backup play)
Add demo checklist flags for reliability: `--model`, `--batch`, `--quant`.

Olivia (mktg): Also capture inbound routing: landing form with UTM, immediate thank-you + benchmark PDF, plus SDR alert to #sales-inbound. We want quick SLA on follow-up.

Raj (growth): I'll add a Zap to post a summarized lead card to #sales-inbound and tag the on-call SDR.

Mia (speaker-ops): Timezones note: live session in PDT. For APAC, we’ll push recording + host an async Q&A thread in community Slack next day.

Tomas (host): Run-of-show draft (pasting short timings from the doc):

```
00:00 - 00:01 Host intro / housekeeping
00:01 - 00:03 Market problem + TL;DR (what teams lose without good serving)
00:03 - 00:10 Demo 1 — Hosted API (low-latency path)
00:10 - 00:16 Demo 2 — Dedicated (steady throughput, reserved capacity)
00:16 - 00:20 Demo 3 — Quantized/edge variant (unit-cost focus)
00:20 - 00:24 Quick panel: tradeoffs & quant metrics + CTA
00:24 - 00:30 Live Q&A + clear CTA (benchmark PDF / book consult)
```

Jen (content): Landing CTAs: watch live / get benchmark PDF / book Dedicated consult. I’ll wire up short hero copy and an alt headline for AB test.

Nora (customer-success): Customer quote greenlit — one-liner ready for the hero.

Sam (eng): I'll export the benchmark charts (latency vs batch, cost per 1k tokens) and upload PNG + CSV to the shared folder by Thu EOD. Alex, want me to annotate axes or drop raw files?

Alex (design): Raw + annotated PNGs both pls. I’ll add callouts and make a small one-page PDF to use as the gated benchmark asset.

Olivia (mktg): Rehearsal owners: tech dry-run = Sam + Alex + Mia; full dress = everyone. Fallback rule: if live demo fails, swap to pre-recorded 90–120s video clip for that segment. Sam, can you record short fallback clips?

Sam (eng): Yep — will record 3 bite-sized videos (one per demo) and upload to the drive. Will include console commands and a tiny readme.

Raj (growth): :thumbsup: Promo calendar — I’ll schedule 3 promos: announcement, reminder, final push + organic posts. Need final abstracts by Thu noon to hit the first wave.

Nora (customer-success): Customer permission email sent, confirmed.

Olivia (mktg): Great. Final asks: keep the webinar tight under 30m; cut demos early if we fall behind. I updated the doc with owners and checklists — link above. Thanks everyone, let’s aim for a clean rehearsal on Wed.
